observations.name: Last name and contact email are optional
Login reservation has exactly one owner
Incomplete anonymization cannot become a tombstone
Four declared trigram search indexes exist

indexes.indexdef: CREATE INDEX "User_contactEmail_idx" ON public."User" USING btree ("contactEmail")
CREATE INDEX "User_contactEmail_trgm_idx" ON public."User" USING gin ("contactEmail" gin_trgm_ops)
CREATE INDEX "User_deletedAt_createdAt_idx" ON public."User" USING btree ("deletedAt", "createdAt")
CREATE INDEX "User_deletedAt_idx" ON public."User" USING btree ("deletedAt")
CREATE INDEX "User_deletedAt_isActive_idx" ON public."User" USING btree ("deletedAt", "isActive")
CREATE INDEX "User_deletedAt_lastLoginAt_idx" ON public."User" USING btree ("deletedAt", "lastLoginAt")
CREATE INDEX "User_deletedAt_lockedUntil_idx" ON public."User" USING btree ("deletedAt", "lockedUntil")
CREATE INDEX "User_deletedAt_mustChangePassword_idx" ON public."User" USING btree ("deletedAt", "mustChangePassword")
CREATE INDEX "User_deletedAt_role_idx" ON public."User" USING btree ("deletedAt", role)
CREATE INDEX "User_firstName_trgm_idx" ON public."User" USING gin ("firstName" gin_trgm_ops)
CREATE INDEX "User_lastName_trgm_idx" ON public."User" USING gin ("lastName" gin_trgm_ops)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "User_loginName_key" ON public."User" USING btree ("loginName")
CREATE INDEX "User_loginName_trgm_idx" ON public."User" USING gin ("loginName" gin_trgm_ops)
CREATE INDEX "User_mfaEnabledAt_idx" ON public."User" USING btree ("mfaEnabledAt")
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "User_pkey" ON public."User" USING btree (id)
CREATE INDEX "User_role_idx" ON public."User" USING btree (role)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "User_single_protected_root_key" ON public."User" USING btree ("isProtected") WHERE ("isProtected" = true)
